definitions.explanation: The removal or elimination of people from an organization, especially for political reasons.
Removing corrupt or undesirable members from an organization. The object is people; for correcting wrongdoing or discipline itself, the word is {粛正|しゅくせい}.

examples.japanese: ⟦{独裁者|どくさいしゃ}→独裁者：15406_dokusaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{反対派|はんたいは}→反対派：30532_hantaiha⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{粛清|しゅくせい}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{党内|とうない}→党内：31645_tounai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{大規模|だいきぼ}→大規模：12185_daikibo⟧な{粛清|しゅくせい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: A large-scale purge was carried out within the party.

examples.japanese: スターリン⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{粛清|しゅくせい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{犠牲|ぎせい}→犠牲：14743_gisei⟧になった。
examples.english: Many people fell victim to the purges during the Stalin era.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{反対|はんたい}する→反対する：05648_hantaisuru⟧⟦{幹部|かんぶ}→幹部：06875_kanbu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{次々|つぎつぎ}→次々：03522_tsugitsugi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{粛清|しゅくせい}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The company president purged the executives who opposed him, one after another.

examples.japanese: ⟦{不正|ふせい}→不正：01660_fusei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{関|かか}わった→関わる：03020_kakawaru⟧⟦{職員|しょくいん}→職員：20206_shokuin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{組織|そしき}→組織：03320_soshiki⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{粛清|しゅくせい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To purge the staff involved in wrongdoing from the organization.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{粛清|しゅくせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{対象|たいしょう}→対象：03393_taishou⟧となり、{失脚|しっきゃく}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He became a target of the purge and fell from power.

notes:
USAGE:
Often used in political and historical contexts, particularly regarding authoritarian regimes. Can also be used more broadly for cleaning up corruption.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {粛清|しゅくせい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{嵐|あらし}→嵐：01695_arashi⟧ - purge storm (wave of purges)
- ⟦{政治的|せいじてき}→政治的：05684_seijiteki⟧{粛清|しゅくせい} - political purge
- {大粛清|だいしゅくせい} - Great Purge (historical)
- {粛清|しゅくせい}⟦{対象|たいしょう}→対象：03393_taishou⟧ - target of a purge

ETYMOLOGY:
{粛|しゅく} (strict, solemn) + {清|せい} (cleanse). Strongly associated with Stalin's Great Purge ({大粛清|だいしゅくせい}).

WATCH OUT:
Do not confuse it with the homophone {粛正|しゅくせい} (enforcing discipline, correcting wrongdoing), as in {綱紀粛正|こうきしゅくせい} (tightening official discipline). {粛清|しゅくせい} removes people; {粛正|しゅくせい} corrects conduct.
